title: Mines
description: Clear the field without touching a mine. Numbers tell you how many mines are next to each square. Your first move is always safe.

title: Nonogram
description: Use the number clues to fill the right squares and reveal the pattern. A new daily puzzle every day, the same for everyone.

title: Sudoku
description: Fill the grid so every row, column and 3×3 box contains the digits 1 to 9. Every puzzle has exactly one solution.
